+"""RoboPaint controller for copying the target with the virtual brush.
+
+Run once in the provided rcb-limited/2.0 episode. Coordinates are brush-tip
+targets in world metres; the same vertical brush orientation is used throughout.
+"""
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+Q_DOWN = np.array([-3.9874308e-7, 1.0, -3.5553239e-7, -2.8657269e-8], dtype=float)
+DT = 0.05
+
+def route(points, spacing=0.003):
+    """Interpolate a list of XYZ waypoints into slow, straight EE targets."""
+    rows = []
+    for a, b in zip(points[:-1], points[1:]):
+        a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a) / spacing)))
+        for j in range(1, n+1):
+            p = a + (b-a) * (j/n)
+            rows.append(np.r_[p, Q_DOWN])
+    return np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+
+def run():
+    r = Robot()
+    spec = r.spec()
+    print("connected", spec["protocol"], r.status())
+    # Ink pickup, then a calibration mark on the practice sheet.
+    dip_and_practice = route([
+        [0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0932],
+        [-0.1000, 0.1500, 0.0750],
+        [-0.1000, 0.1500, 0.0220],
+        [-0.1000, 0.1500, 0.0220],
+        [-0.1000, 0.1500, 0.0750],
+        [-0.1000, -0.1856, 0.0750],
+        [-0.1000, -0.1856, 0.0180],
+        [-0.1000, -0.1856, 0.0180],
+        [-0.1000, -0.1856, 0.0180],
+        [-0.1000, -0.1656, 0.0180],
+        [-0.1000, -0.1656, 0.0750],
+    ])
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", dip_and_practice, dt=DT,
+                   cameras=("practice_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"),
+                   video_fps=5, video="both", note="ink dip and practice width test")
+    res.save("/app/output/calibration")
+    print("calibration meta", res.meta)
+    print("final proprio", res.proprio[-1] if res.proprio is not None else None)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run()
*** End Patch";

+def pixel_world(uv):
